newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia could aim for 5 pct jobless - Fraser.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia could aim for 5 pct jobless - Fraser.

text.p: The retiring governor of the Reserve Bank of Australia, Bernie Fraser, said Australia might aim for a five or six percent unemployment rate, although achieving it involved issues other than monetary policy.

Asked to nominate an achievable unemployment target, Fraser said: "Well you can ask a lot of people and you can get a lot of different answers, but I don't see any reason why we couldn't be aiming to get down to five or six percent and see what happens when we get there, if we get there.
"But, as I say, there are issues involved here that go way beyond monetary policy," he told a parliamentary committee.
Official figures released earlier on Thursday showed Australia's unemployment rate increased to 8.8 percent, seasonally-adjusted, in August, from 8.5 percent the previous month.
The government has forecast unemployment to fall to 8.25 percent in the June quarter, 1997.
